candidate.definition_en: Relating to the Middle Ages (roughly 500–1500 AD).
candidate.explanation_ar: حاجة ليها علاقة بالعصور الوسطى، زمن القلاع والفرسان.

senses.definition_en: Connected with or dating from the Middle Ages in European history.
senses.definition_ar: متعلق بالعصور الوسطى في التاريخ الأوروبي.
examples: We visited a medieval town in France.
The museum has a collection of medieval art.

senses.definition_en: Extremely old-fashioned, primitive, or harsh (used disapprovingly).
senses.definition_ar: متخلف أو بدائي أو قاسٍ بشكل مبالغ فيه (مجازياً).
examples: The legal system was described as positively medieval.
We visited a medieval town in France.
The museum has a collection of medieval art.
The legal system was described as positively medieval.
candidate.mnemonic: فيها 'Mid' يعني وسط.. 'Medieval' يعني العصور الوسطى.
